build_combined_dataset: build a CombinedDataset from multiple dataset configs with a shared processing pipeline
get_subset_index: get the subset index and local index for a global sample index in CombinedDataset
prepare_data_combined: prepare and transform data for a given index using the CombinedDataset pipeline
get_data_info_combined: get the annotation dict for a global index across all sub-datasets in CombinedDataset
build_multi_image_mix_dataset: build a MultiImageMixDataset with mosaic or mixup augmentation transforms and skip keys
